assets.momonga: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG game character sprite used in a side-scrolling runner and large homepage illustration. Draw exactly one Momonga (モモンガ) from Chiikawa, recognizable faithful appearance: tiny plump white flying squirrel, pale powder-blue outer ears/back and enormous fluffy pale blue tail curling behind to the LEFT, rounded ears with pink inner areas, huge expressive glossy black eyes, tiny black mouth, pink cheek blush, white face and belly, short tiny paws. Facing RIGHT in a lively running pose, three-quarter side view so the face is visible, feet apart and one paw forward. Keep whole character including tail and feet visible with 5% transparent margin, character fills canvas. No ground, no scenery, no text, no labels, no watermark, no badge, no border. Actual transparent alpha background. Single character single frame, not a sprite sheet.
